correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the maximality trichotomy: one unassigned A forces all agents to hold B, so all A unassigned and all B allocated, and symmetrically. With identical unit chores EF1 is precisely max load - min load <=1. Splitting each part among its unique labeled recipient agents yields C and E_n formulas; if no side has >=n items, the singleton/two-item construction yields a complete equitable allocation. If no complete solution, retaining the larger side gives max(a,b) items >=(a+b)/2; K_(2h-1,2h+1) with four agents h>=3 blocks four bundles of size h and approaches half. Independently enumerated every assignment for n=2,3 and a,b<=3, matching count and throughput.
residual_risks: Uniform costs, complete bipartite conflict, labeled agents/items and inclusion-maximal partial allocations only.
